description: This Dart file defines the RealtimeClient class responsible for managing WebSocket connections, handling incoming messages, and emitting events related to real-time online interactions in a mobile application.

classes.name: RealtimeClient
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connection to a real-time server, handles incoming messages, and provides a stream of events for online interactions.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the specified URI and starts listening for incoming messages.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and releases associated resources.

methods.name: sendJson
methods.description: Sends a JSON-encoded message through the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: _handleIncoming
methods.description: Internal method to process incoming data from the WebSocket stream and emit appropriate events.
